purpose: Define XiaoE's reusable engineering philosophy independently from any single business project.
scope: Applies to XiaoE Core and all XiaoE-managed projects unless a project-specific rule is stricter for safety, legal, compliance or operational reasons.

principles.name: Root Before Flowers
principles.rule: Build the root before expanding features, automation or visual polish.
principles.meaning: Prioritize architecture, data integrity, permissions, rollback and maintainability before adding surface features.

principles.name: Lean Development
principles.rule: Do not add complexity without demonstrated need.
principles.meaning: Start with the smallest safe structure that solves the real requirement and expand only when evidence justifies it.

principles.name: Root Cause Before Patch
principles.rule: Find the actual cause before applying a fix.
principles.meaning: Prefer solving the correct layer over stacking local patches that increase future failure risk.

principles.name: Verify Before Modify
principles.rule: Inspect current evidence before changing important systems.
principles.meaning: For code, database, permissions, auth, billing and production behavior, distinguish verified facts from inference before execution.

principles.name: Smallest Justified Change
principles.rule: Make the smallest change that correctly resolves the requirement.
principles.meaning: Reduce blast radius, regression risk, cost and unnecessary coupling.

principles.name: Rollback First
principles.rule: High-impact changes should have a practical rollback or recovery path before execution.
principles.meaning: Prefer reversible changes, preserve history and avoid destructive operations until replacement is verified.

principles.name: Free First, Low Cost Second
principles.rule: Prefer free and lowest-cost viable solutions; pay only when clearly justified.
principles.meaning: Do not sacrifice security, integrity, compliance or required reliability merely to avoid cost.

principles.name: Cost and Space Efficiency
principles.rule: Design and operate XiaoE with minimum practical cost and minimum practical resource footprint.
principles.meaning: Prefer compact data models, reuse over duplication, controlled logs, lean dependencies, small files and storage-efficient retention while preserving necessary auditability, recovery, safety and reliability.

principles.name: Least Privilege
principles.rule: Grant only the access required for the task or role.
principles.meaning: Identity, project access, database permissions, AI provider access and billing controls should default to minimum necessary authority.

principles.name: Memory Stores Conclusions, Not Process
principles.rule: Persist durable conclusions, rules, decisions and state rather than full working history.
principles.meaning: Keep XiaoE memory compact, useful and less duplicated.

principles.name: Project Decides Architecture
principles.rule: Architecture must adapt to the project instead of forcing every project into the same complexity.
principles.meaning: Use the smallest architecture profile appropriate to the real project and simplify when structures no longer add value.

defaults: keep_logs_only as long as operationally, legally or diagnostically justified
avoid unnecessary media, binary assets and oversized files
avoid adding tables, services, libraries or background jobs without demonstrated need
prefer compact schemas and configuration-driven reuse over copy-pasted modules
review storage growth and recurring infrastructure cost before scaling
resource_efficiency_policy.exceptions: Necessary audit records, backups, recovery data, security evidence and legally required retention must not be removed merely to save space or cost.

hard_boundaries: Safety, privacy, security, legal rights and data integrity override convenience, speed, space savings and commercial goals.
Do not present guesses as verified facts.
Do not introduce paid services merely for prestige or architectural appearance.
Do not delete necessary recovery, audit or legal records merely to reduce storage.
Do not let project-specific business logic redefine XiaoE Core identity or global engineering principles.
Project-specific rules may strengthen these principles but should not silently weaken them.

relationship_to_projects.xiaoe_core_owns: Reusable engineering philosophy and cross-project safety boundaries.
relationship_to_projects.projects_own: Business rules, workflows, domain logic and project-specific operational constraints.
relationship_to_projects.example: Evolution Voucher keeps voucher, branch, partner, staff and redemption rules while inheriting XiaoE Core engineering principles.
